items.stem: What is the main security benefit of network segmentation?

options.text: It limits how far an attacker can move after gaining a foothold
options.rationale: Correct: segmentation contains lateral movement between zones.
Segmentation and encryption address different risks.

options.text: It guarantees no attacker can enter
options.rationale: No control guarantees prevention; segmentation limits impact.
Segmentation reduces, not increases, exposure between zones.

items.stem: Which TWO protocols provide encryption in transit? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: SSH encrypts remote administration sessions.
Correct: TLS encrypts data in transit for many services.
Telnet sends data, including credentials, in clear text.
Plain HTTP is unencrypted; HTTPS adds TLS.

items.explanation: Correct: SSH and TLS both encrypt traffic in transit.
